statementNote: Payment due within 14 days by bank transfer. Thank you for the work.

_notes.name: The person or studio named at the top of every statement.
_notes.currency: Three-letter currency code for rates and statement totals, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.
_notes.clients: One object per client: id (lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; entries are stored by it, so keep it once hours exist), name (as printed on the statement), rate (per hour, in currency), and color (six-digit hex, used for the client's bars and chip).
_notes.rounding: Minutes each entry rounds up to on a statement: 0 bills to the minute, 6 is tenths of an hour, 15 is quarter hours. Entries always keep their exact time, and the person can change this in Settings.
_notes.weekStart: mon or sun: the first day of the Week view and of the calendars.
_notes.theme: studio (warm graphite, bone readout, brass glow), ledger (cream paper, blue-black ink, brass), or auto (follows the device). Statements print on ledger paper in every theme.
_notes.sample: true fills a first visit with five weeks of example hours and a running timer, so the page shows what it does; false opens empty. Clear all hours in Settings removes them.
_notes.statementNote: Optional line at the foot of every statement, such as payment terms.
